nom: Dr. Melaxin CACTOX Pore Relief Jelly Serum Mist

avis.texte: All I can say is that it's day 3, and my pores are visibly smaller. I have giant pores, so this was easy to see. What is this magic? I can't wait to see what's next.
Only been using a week, loving it so far only because it doesn't leave my skin looking greasy like most of their products do. I'm not the one who wants glass looking skin lol.

The dr.melaxin cactox pore relief serum is a great buy! I wash my face then use toner and use the serum then use moisturizer. The serum absorbs well and doesn't leave my face sticky. I have sensitive skin and this product does not irritate my skin at all. I have noticed and improvement with my red undertone and improved pore size.
Love this line of skincare. It’s never steered me wrong. Great moisturizing products! Skin feels so smooth and supple afterwards.
Dr.Melaxin Cactox Pore Relief Serum 80l works minimizes face skin pores.

avis.titre: Soothing, cool, calming serum from an awesome skin care line!
avis.texte: I ordered the Dr.Melaxin Cactox Pore Relief Serum - Pore Minimizer & Hydrating Face Serum - since I have been using this brand for many months, and if you're at all on TikTok, you've surely seen the videos on this brand, and product line. I've been using the Cemenrete product line for many months and I really love it, but then this new cactus line came out, and after doing some research about cactus products in regard to skin care, I was very interested. Cactii have evolved to retain moisture for months in very dry environments, and especially prickly pear (Opuntia ficus‑indica)—are packed with water, antioxidants, vitamins, and fatty acids that make them powerful skincare ingredients. These products are excellent for dry skin - they are very rich in natural moisturizing compounds, and polysaccharides that help the skin retain wate, and High water content plumps the skin and improves elasticity. It's oil contains vitamin E and omega‑6 fatty acids that also nourish and protect the skin barrier. This serum is similar to the other line's serum I use, it makes your skin feel so hydrated and smooth, it's very calming and soothing. Cactus in particular helps close pores, minimize their appearance, and has a wonderful cooling effect. There are other ingredients, such as flavanoids, that help to brighten the skin, and reduce the appearance of redness, or even dark spots. I mean, it's no miracle fix, but it can definitely slow the appearance of future age spots. And of course, antioxi

I’ve become somewhat of a face serum snob recently. Always looking for that one to put on after I give my face a good wash. Good lord, am I a 47 year old dad of three who now has a skincare routine? Well here we are. I’ve acquired several lately so I’m able to do some comparison. This one is more of a thick gel. Another one I have is almost a pure oil. This one is like an oil mixed with aloe Vera gel. I’m not saying it has aloe Vera, but that’s the vibe I get from it. Very nice serum that trends away from the pure oil feel of others and leans toward gel. The packaging is all very nice and the dropper for this is top notch. I was pleasantly surprised to see how snugly the dropper cylinder fits into the bottle. As you pull it out, it scrapes off all the serum from the outside of the dropper. No drips. No wasted product. Smell wise: completely inert. I don’t smell anything. It’s easy to use as I just put 4 or 5 drops on my fingers and rub it around. The consistency of this one requires a bit more per use than my purely oil serums. But I’m guessing this bottle will last several months at my current consumption rate. Overall, happy with the purchase.

avis.titre: Hydrating serum from a great brand
avis.texte: I use various Dr. Melaxin products from the Cremenrete and Cactox lines, so I was excited to see the Cactox Pore Relief Serum. The other products from this line work well, and I expect the same from this. The serum is thick and applies smoothly. The bottle contains 80ml, and a little goes a long way, so a bottle this size will last a while. Like the other Cactox products, there is a scent that I think comes from the cactus plants. It's a pleasant smell similar to cucumber scented items, but with a hint of floral. It's crisp, but the floral get to me. That said, if you are sensitive to scented products on your face, this may be a little strong for you. It's definitely strong to me. However, the serum is less scented than some of the other products in this line. Scent aside, the serum feels great on my skin. Like any beauty product, it typically takes weeks or months to see effects. For reference, I have been using Dr. Melaxin Cremenete balm and Calcium Ampoule daily for nearly two months, and it took me about six weeks to see noticeable results. I have not been using the Pore Relief Serum long enough to notice more than the immediate moisturizing effects. I expect great results, though. I will report back on my results in a few months. Dr. Melaxin products are quality Korean beauty products, and this serum adds moisture to my skin, so I expect great things from this. The price is great for a reputable brand.

avis.titre: Another Great Product From the Cactox Line — Hydrating, Smoothing, and Gentle
avis.texte: I’m 52 and post-menopausal with dry, mature skin, and I’ve been really impressed with Dr. Melaxin’s Cactox line overall. I’ve tried a few products from this range already, and this Cactox Pore Relief Serum continues that same experience — gentle, hydrating, and effective without being harsh. The first thing I noticed is the texture. It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly, but still feels hydrating and supportive. It layers easily with other products and works well both morning and night without feeling sticky or heavy. What I like most is that this helps smooth overall skin texture while still being gentle enough for mature skin. Some pore-focused products can be drying, but this one actually hydrates while refining, which is a big plus for me. My skin looks more even and feels softer with continued use. The hydration level is also excellent, thanks to the hyaluronic acid. My skin stays comfortable throughout the day, and I don’t get that tight feeling that sometimes comes with lighter serums. It gives a subtle healthy glow and makes my skin look more refreshed overall. I also appreciate how gentle this serum is. There’s no irritation, no tingling, and it plays well with the rest of my routine. It feels like it’s improving my skin gradually rather than pushing it too hard. Another plus is the large 80ml size, which makes this a great value compared to many serums that are much smaller. Since you don’t need a lot per use, this should last quite a while. avis.titre: Nice texture but unfortunately too scented for me
avis.texte: This serum has a nice lightweight texture and absorbs well into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. It also seems hydrating and could be a good option for someone looking to minimize the appearance of pores. However, it wasn’t for me because I really didn’t like the smell. The scent was a bit too strong and lingered more than I prefer, which made it hard to keep using it consistently. Overall, it seems like a decent product in terms of performance, but if you’re sensitive to fragrance, it might not be the best fit.

avis.titre: Hydrating Serum That Makes Skin Look Smooth
avis.texte: I’ve been using this serum consistently since I got it in the mail, and I must say it’s easily a 5 out of 5 for me. It’s fairly lightweight, and sinks in quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky feeling behind. When it comes to pores or dark spots, there's no such thing as "instant" change or improvement, I believe. With Dr. Melaxin Cactox Pore Relief Serum as well, I’ve noticed my skin looked smoother and more even over time. My pores didn’t magically disappear (nothing really does that), but they definitely look less noticeable, and my skin has that soft, slightly blurred look. However, I must admit, pores look naturally a bit more enlarged in warmer temperature, so cooler weather may be helping this look. Another plus is how well it layers. I’ve had zero issues using it with other products or under makeup -- no pilling, no weird texture, just plays nicely with everything. It’s not an overnight miracle, but with consistent use, it really helps balance the skin and improve texture in a natural, gradual way. If you’re looking for something lightweight that smooths, hydrates, and keeps oil under control, that is affordable, this one is definitely worth trying.

avis.titre: Good feel, nice smell, and absorbs fast
avis.texte: I’ve been using this for about 4–5 days now and so far I like it. It has a nice, light scent and the texture is great, not too runny at all (you can see that in my photo), so it’s easy to control when applying. It spreads well and absorbs pretty quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. It’s too early to say if it’s actually improving pores yet, I haven’t noticed a visible difference so far, but I wouldn’t expect that in less than a week anyway. What I have noticed is that it leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated after using it. My wife has been using it too and she has more sensitive skin, no irritation or reactions for either of us which is a big plus. The glass dropper bottle is nice and feels more premium than typical plastic ones. So far, solid product. Just need more time to see if it delivers on the pore claims.

This Dr.Melaxin Cactox Pore Relief Serum seems like a great product. So far, it has really agreed with my skin, making it feel smooth and hydrated. This product is for minimizing your pores, calming your skin and hydrating your face. I’ve noticed that my pores have seemed very large for the past few years so I was thrilled to find this product. It has triple Hyaluronic Acid, niacinamide, flower and fruit extracts, and cactus mucilage to help support your skin. This is a medium consistency serum, not thin like water, but not super thick. It went on smoothly and absorbed quickly. It does have a very light perfume fragrance to it but it’s mild. It did make my skin feel slightly sticky after I applied it, maybe I need to use a less of the product. All in all, I think this is a good product at a fair price. I’m excited to use it for a few months hoping to see improvements in my the texture of my skin.

avis.titre: Not a bad serum for a reasonable price
avis.texte: I feel like products from this company are always either a hit or miss for me personally, but this was not the worst of the ones I've tried. This is a decent serum, with good ingredients, though if you're careful about fragrances, have a look at the ingredients list. There is fragrance added, so it's not completely unscented. Yet, for the current price of only $20 you get 50 ml, which is generous for a serum. And it performs well for my combination mature skin, so no complaints there.

avis.titre: ideal smooth and non-sticky texture absorbs well, but very fragranced
avis.texte: I ordered this because I love trying new skincare, and have had good experiences with cactus-derived ingredients in the past. I love to layer serums and this one sounded like it would work well in that way. The good news: this serum has a very lightweight, quick-to-absorb texture that my skin just drinks in and responds well to. It gives an immediate hydration boost, a visible bit of "bounce" without any stickiness or thicker "cushion"-like feel, and works well layered with other skincare. High praise here for better-looking and -feeling skin in a very easy to apply serum. I did remove a star because the fragrance is very strong to me. It is not a bad fragrance; I'd call it a sweet green-herbal type scent, and I find it less offensive than sharp florals, but WOW it just seems strong to me. I'd proceed with caution for anyone sensitive to fragrance or not wanting to be able to smell their face for at least several hours. Like all the Dr. Melaxin products, I find this to be budget-priced, especially considering the good results and quality ingredients.

This is a nice serum for someone who just wants a little extra boost of hydration. It has a fairly thin texture and it absorbs into the skin well without leaving an overly sticky or tacky finish. It does have a scent--it's a fresh, "green" scent - - which might bother some people although I actually like it. I don't feel like this has really done anything to significantly change the look of my pores but it does give my skin a slight glow. This isn't doing anything amazing for me but it's nice, it's affordable, and I always appreciate a little extra hydration.

avis.titre: Soothing, calming serum with a fresh aloe feel
avis.texte: This is a thicker, gel-like serum—definitely more substantial than your typical watery formulas. It has a slight green tint and a fresh, aloe-like scent that immediately feels calming when you apply it. It spreads easily and gives a nice cooling, soothing effect on the skin. After about a week of use, I noticed it genuinely helped reduce some redness and irritation I was dealing with, which was a pleasant surprise. It feels hydrating without being greasy, and it layers well with other products. As for pore-minimizing claims, I didn’t see a dramatic change there yet, but the smoothing and calming benefits are real. Overall, this feels like a great option if your skin is irritated, sensitive, or just needs something gentle and hydrating to reset.

avis.titre: I am in Love - Thick and Effective Serum
avis.texte: I ordered the Dr. Melaxin Cactox Pore Relief Serum and this is like a magic potion! My skin is not terrible but I have always larger pores and the occasional small breakouts since having my son. This serum is amazing and i don’t know how I will live without it now! The serum comes in a glass bottle with a dropper and it is the perfect thicker than normal serum consistency. It stays on without dripping all down my face but spreads on smoothly and easily. The serum has a nice fresh scent and I like that it does have a scent to it. There is no sticky residue and I did not have any adverse effects. What I was left with was smooth, even looking skin and oh so soft! I will continue to use this serum daily and will definitely repurchase when I run out. So happy!

avis.titre: Finally Seeing a Difference in My Pores! Even in My 60s!
avis.texte: This is my first time trying this serum, and I’m honestly impressed. I’m in my mid 60s and have always had very large pores, so noticeable you could see them from across the table. I didn’t expect a miracle, but this has truly made a visible difference! My pores already look diminished, and my skin appears smoother and more even. I was worried it might dry my skin out, but it does the complete opposite, it leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and comfortable. It absorbs nicely, feels lightweight, and gives my skin a healthy, moisturized look. I’m excited to keep using it and see even more improvement over time. For the price, the value is fantastic for the results. Highly recommend!

This stuff is the best skincare product I have put on my skin. It has the refreshing, lightly floral and cucumber scent. It literally made my bad skin feel plump and hydrated the second I put it on. Its not greasy at all but did stay a little sticky until it fully absorbed, which took 5-10 minutes. Afterwards, my skin was so soft, I couldn't stop touching it! This serum has convinced me that I NEED the entire Cactox line. Im OBSESSED!!!!!! And the fact that its at an actually affordable pricepoint is just the cherry on top. My photos added have a before serum, with serum and after the serum has absorbed.

I love this brand. I have several products from this company but this is the first time I have tried the Cactox line. It love and appreciate the larger size of this serum. Very valuable size. The feeling was wonderful on my skin. I used the Cactox peel shot followed by this serum. And just from the first use I could tell a difference. The cooling feel on my skin was relaxing and wonderful. Can’t wait to see the long term results. Left skin feeling soft and refreshed.

A nice addition to your face care routine. Easy to apply and goes on smooth and light-weight and absorbs well, leaving the skin soft and supple. Half the box is written in korean, and the other half in english. Has a really long list of unpronounceable ingredients. Not too pricey, especially how you don't need a lot for each application. Approx 3 years expiration date. Made in Korea.

Pros: - This comes in a good quality glass bottle with a stopper that works well to dispense the amount of serum across my face. - The price point of $20 is a good value for this quality product. - It has a slight smell of cactus, which I find pleasant. The smell dissipates once you rub in the serum. - It absorbs well and doesn't irritate my skin. Cons: - It's a bit on the watery side, so it doesn't deliver quite as much long term hydration as some more expensive serums. But this is fine for the price.

I am loving this serum! The bottle is quite large which is always a bonus. The serum is very similar to aloe based products. It’s a thick which I am a fan of so it doesn’t run down your face when you apply it. It gives a mild cooling and soothing feeling when you apply it which is so relaxing. It feels super hydrating and leaves you with that beautiful glass skin feeling. The product says it’s made in Korea and certainly seems to deliver everything it promises. I also love the look and packaging. Everything about it feels luxurious and pampering. I definitely recommend if you’re looking for a soothing, hydrating, and relaxing item to add to your skin scare routine!
